task.name: warehouse_tote_loading
task.description: Simple humanoid manipulation task: pick packages from the conveyor and place them into the open tote bin. Keep all STL meshes axis-aligned. Do not rotate any mesh unless rotation is explicitly listed below.
task.success_condition: Place all package objects inside tote_open_bin without crossing the tote walls. Package bottoms should be above the tote floor.

coordinate_convention.origin_rule: Every STL origin is bottom-center of its bounding box.
coordinate_convention.orientation_rule: Z-up. X is left-right. Y is front-back. All files are exported already upright.
coordinate_convention.threejs_rule: Load with STLLoader, create Mesh, set mesh.position from the placement values, and leave mesh.rotation at 0,0,0 unless rotation_deg is specified. If using three.js default coordinates, this scene already matches three.js Y-horizontal/Z-up conventions when you treat Z as vertical in your controls/physics layer.

spawn_area.description: Top surface of conveyor, where packages begin.

target_container.description: Inside of tote. Place packages here.

robot_task_interface.movement_note: This task only needs short reach, wrist alignment, grasp, lift 0.15-0.35m, translate, lower, and release. No walking required.
